_readme: Copy this file to goobi.local.json (same folder), fill it in, run `npm run build`, then load/reload dist/. On a FRESH install (remove + re-add — which wipes extension storage) Goobi seeds every EMPTY setting from this file; it never overwrites values you've since edited in the side panel, so the panel stays the source of truth. goobi.local.json is GITIGNORED because it holds real keys in plaintext — keep it on this machine only, never commit or share it, and rotate any key that leaks.
niche: AI SaaS, indie founders, MRR; posts I can add a specific build lesson to
voice: Paste 3-6 replies you actually wrote, one per line. Or leave "" and use the panel's Learn my voice.
